adaptations.damage: Base contact10 (Tainted20), shot10, field8; existing hostile multiplier1.25 remains. Normal/Drowned/Tainted blast100 enemy and20 base player, radius3: these are local values, NOT recovered native Boom Fly damage.
adaptations.fields: Dragon range30/spacing1.25/progression.025s/duration4; fire clips at ground terrain/cover/water. Sick trail.6s/radius.7/duration2.5; eight death clouds at radius2.25 with cloud radius1.3/duration12. Existing gas contact policy is local.
adaptations.tainted: Warning .6s, line spacing2/delay.065 per step, max range100. Real flight boundaries/cliffs end the line; interior cover does not. Actual blast collision shields actors. Stationary warnings are not physical bombs.
adaptations.lifecycle: Ordinary and non-debug execution deaths produce attacks, debug execution suppresses them. Gas/fire use existing room-clear cleanup. Real delayed blasts persist after ordinary clear, pause outside active room, and have active128/pending256 caps; pending fuses start on admission. Over-cap work logs suppression.
adaptations.placement: Bands use positive authored habitats, sparse per-room caps and costs3/4; no opening-band family. Normal/Red bands1-3; Drowned Flooded1 and2; Dragon/X/Bone standard1; Sick3. Tainted remains unrouted dedicated Ascent work.
adaptations.replacement: Normal-to-Red phase0 probability949/10000; Flooded normal-or-Red-to-Drowned phase1 probability5000/10000. Phases use independent seeded slot streams, preserve original source, reserve conservative worst-case cumulative threat. Dross exclusion cannot be encoded until a distinct Dross context exists.
adaptations.presentation: Original renderer, procedural fly silhouettes, variant colors/face markers, X/cross eyes, skull/teeth, bloated gas sacs; bone projectiles elongated and green shots nonexplosive. No source art imported. Dragon cross/X is also shown on the upper shell, because the face can point away from the camera.

contract.movement: Stationary attacks, short in-place hops, and jumps toward the player.
contract.targeting: Cardinal down/side laser triggers; never fires upward.
contract.attacks: Fixed-orientation eight-shot bursts, large red creep, paired eye-socket lasers, eight shots plus creep on jump landing; whole-heart source contact.
contract.vulnerability: Grounded/windup vulnerable, complete airborne immunity is current explicit 3D adaptation; source window remains unverified.
contract.phases: Two owned eyes detached from start. Green form replaces short/long-hop rings with two/three arcing explosive shots, uses green creep and summons two Chargers on large-creep action.
contract.offspring: Owns two Bloat Eyes; green form also summons ordinary Chargers with separate summon ownership.
contract.completion: Boss defeat removes its eyes and pays the encounter reward exactly once.

adaptations.hp: Bloat 450*3.2=1440; normal Charger 20*3.2=64. Invulnerable eye HP remains the local sentinel 1, not a source HP conversion.
adaptations.damage: Bloat contact 20, beams/shots/creep/eye/Charger contact 10, green blast 20 before hostile multiplier1.25. Starting player remains100 HP/24 damage.
adaptations.attacks: Local cooldown2.4/windup.5; large jump .9s, range7, apex3.8..6; short hop .35s/apex.7. Existing movement/aggression multipliers apply. Grounded/windup damageable; complete airborne immunity is explicit local policy, not verified source timing.
adaptations.lasers: Fixed world south corresponds to source down; two parallel front rays or opposed side rays from sockets. Range32/radius.32/duration.7/recovery1.5/alignment.8 are local. Geometry is clipped at creation; solid cover also guards damage. No added telegraph delay.
adaptations.creep: Large radius3, landing radius1, lifetime6. Nearby owned deposits refresh rather than unbounded stacking. Large creep action summons ordinary independent Chargers; they survive body death and must be cleared for room completion.
adaptations.ipecac: 1.1s aimed flight, gravity12, lateral spread2, explosion radius2.8/damage20; discrete swept 3D motion and flat-plane fallback only without canyon terrain. Hostile blast does not damage its own faction; it can ignite powder barrels using soft demolition. adaptations.charger: Local dash11 before1.1 movement multiplier, maximum1.5s, alignment.8, recovery.7, wander timers.7..1.8; no anticipation windup. Native exact speed/timer/stop conditions require measurement.
adaptations.selection: Bands2/3 native weight6, Bloat normal3/green1. These weights are local, not source spawn odds. Dedicated stream leaves layout/ordinary selection RNG independent.

contract.unknowns: Native RNG probabilities/timers/acceleration not given by the cited source require measurement or explicitly documented tuning.

contract.movement: Stationary, solid room hazard; no pursuit or ordinary body-contact damage.

adaptations.forces: Normal peak player speed 2 units/s and projectile acceleration 12 units/s²; Broken 4 and 24. Range 24 units with linear falloff, vertical extent 4 units and projectile planar speed limit 40. Existing shots faster than the limit keep their incoming speed ceiling. These are local 3D values, not extracted Isaac constants.
adaptations.multiple_fields: Vectors sum and oppose each other, capped at the strongest participating configured peak. This local cap preserves movement counterplay and bounded acceleration; exact native stacking is unknown.
adaptations.collision: Player displacement is swept against ordinary world geometry and statue solids. Forces do not operate in corridors or inactive rooms. Physical input and aim remain under existing controls; stand-still does not cancel suction.
adaptations.cycle: Broken begins in its active half and alternates every four seconds. Cycle pauses while the room is inactive and resumes on return. Four-second period is sourced; startup phase and offscreen persistence are declared adaptations pending native measurement.
adaptations.visuals: Existing Original-style stone body with a larger dark mouth, Broken cracks and four small inward-moving dust motes; inactive phase closes the mouth. No source art imported.
adaptations.configuration: Forces, extents, cycle and pool weights are external. A current expedition retains its immutable content snapshot after edits.

records.name: Quake Grimace

evidence.supports: Exact installed identity, numeric attributes, zero collision damage and shutdoors false.
Family-specific active/disabled behavior, invulnerability, re-entry and named item/edition exceptions.
Manual per-tuple source contract, positive template routes, inferred versus unknown subtype distinctions and remaining runtime work.
Concrete directional landing/wave implementation, source-backed band and declared adaptations; partial validation attached.

contract.movement: Anchored hop/landing action; no horizontal pursuit.
contract.targeting: Installed animation filename specifies left; other coordinate/arena conventions still need explicit mapping.
contract.attacks: On landing, creates a directional line of rocks; source cadence three seconds. The attack can break a secret/super-secret wall in its path.
contract.vulnerability: Immune to ordinary damage; solid to player movement even with flight. Chaos Card, Little Horn and Euthanasia are documented instant-kill exceptions. Generally respawns on room re-entry after such kills; Stone Eye has a distinct cleared-room re-entry rule. Generic XML HP is not ordinary damageability.
contract.phases: Repeated landing attacks normally continue after ordinary combat ends; pressure plates can deactivate it.
contract.offspring: No ordinary enemy offspring. Infestation 2 can create a Blue Spider on an exceptional kill; separate item dependency.
contract.completion: Does not seal doors. Ordinary clear generally does not stop its attack; plate completion does.

adaptations.coordinates: Installed left/up/right/down animation suffixes map to fixed -X/-Z/+X/+Z. Subtypes never turn toward the player or room center.
adaptations.cycle: Source three-second landing cadence; local startup waits a full cycle. Hop occupies the last 0.45 seconds, reaching one world unit high. Inactive rooms pause phase. Physical stationary footprint remains solid during cosmetic lift.
adaptations.wave: Local moving front speed 10 units/s, radius 0.5, range 32, base damage 10 (12.5 after the unchanged 1.25 hostile multiplier) and 0.5-second visual trail. One hit per front; trail is cosmetic. Wave is planar at ordinary actor height, clipped at terrain and room boundaries. Ordinary enemies are not targets; vulnerable allied companions use their existing shared contact cooldown.
adaptations.barriers: Source attack opens secret/super-secret entrances. DeathWard currently has an optional cache enclosure, not the full Isaac secret-room graph. CacheGate is the explicit local entrance analogue: one wave opens it and pays its existing seeded reward once. CrackedRock also breaks, a local adaptation. OreSeam, CacheSide and structural terrain stay intact. Wave stops on its first solid surface even when that surface breaks; cover is evaluated before destruction. No inventory bomb is spent or explosion/ordinary-kill credit awarded.
adaptations.plate: Pressure plates stop further hops/landings. A previously emitted wave finishes its finite course, like other emitted attacks. Exact source plate interaction with in-flight rocks remains unmeasured.
adaptations.placement: Separate one-hazard budget, source-backed band 1 only, fixed inward-facing axis with at least six clear travel units and optional reachable plate. Existing room/ordinary-threat budgets unchanged.
adaptations.visuals: Original procedural stone head, broad brow/directional wedge, anchored hop and travelling low-poly rock crest. No source art or map style changes.

contract.unknowns: Exact native projectile speed, firing interval/selection, collision shape and effect-specific status/timing exceptions are not established. Pressure plates, instant-kill items, reroll behavior, re-entry and projectile-hit item hooks need concrete runtime support and tests.

placement.note: Actual source-band-1 route verified in 170-floor regression, fixed axis and usable lane, reachable plate, independent hazard budget.

behavior.scope: All four fixed axes; no horizontal pursuit; actual hop before three-second landing; three-second repeat period; moving front at configured speed; real player damage through existing multiplier; one hit per front; airborne/cover/corridor protection; first-surface demolition independent of prop order; cache reward once and intact bomb inventory/kill/explosion accounting; persistent opened geometry; ordinary-clear and plate/re-entry policy; inactive phase pause; hazard-cap suppression; file-only speed edit and snapshot isolation.

reachability.scope: All four directional Quakes found in real band-1 generated rooms, with fixed inward axes, usable attack lane, optional reachable plate and retained ordinary residents. The 170-floor regression reaches fourteen separate hazard identities and preserves ordinary room/threat budgets. No Quake opening/tutorial/Mine entries.

visual_linux.scope: Native hop/wave/resident captures and four-axis browser captures inspected in Original style. Broad brow, directional wedge, short fixed-axis chevrons and moving low-poly crest are visible. The first capture revealed a generic warning aimed at an unset target; replaced with short directional arrows. Low contrast against sand and HUD/scenery overlaps still need all-camera readability review. Screenshot FPS is not a controlled performance measurement.

visual_wasm.scope: Four isolated directional variants and four actual generated rooms; all-camera readability not accepted.

balance.scope: Deterministic grounded/airborne/cover contacts preserve player defaults and existing 1.25 hostile impact multiplier; this is not human or varied-build encounter balance acceptance.

performance.scope: Structural bounds: one optional hazard per generated room, existing global hazard cap, finite wave duration and bounded seven-piece visual trail. No controlled native/WASM current-roster benchmark acceptance.

unresolved: Full secret/super-secret-room routing is not implemented by the cache analogue.
Source-exact wave speed, hit radius, damage conversion, hop timing/height, first-cycle phase, geometry interactions and lifetime require measurement.
Named instant-kill, reroll, Infestation 2, Dead Eye and Fire Mind item producers remain dependencies.
All-camera visual readability, mixed-build/human balance and controlled native/WASM performance acceptance remain open.

contract.adaptations: Source40-unit cells map to4 world units. Curved shared physical paths remain a3D adaptation of the native polyline/projection geometry; they are not claimed numerically identical. End stops currently turn at cell center instead of the native4-unit beyond-center endpoint. World rail speed12, flee speed4, opening0.3s, inter-attack delay0.5s and outside1.5s are external. Outside45 and flee90 are interpreted at30Hz as local timing conversions; authored animation30FPS is directly verified, all engine timer rates are not. Cart follows actual swept curve segments. At a wall endpoint an unfinished attack is retained until its final emission/capacity retry completes; this local policy avoids losing ordnance but differs from unreviewed native interruption behavior. Single/double throws predict target velocity by a random0.1-0.3 seconds. Native prediction also multiplies by native target distance; complete units/tick conversion and launch dynamics remain unresolved. Current shared0.7s ballistic lob/fuse and hostile damage remain local tuning. Mine placement tries8 legal candidates and favors spacing; this is only a partial adaptation of the native candidate selection, not an exact recovered sampler. A cart destroyed over a pit dismounts its grounded rider at the nearest legal point. Terrain uses the existing height-field lattice; pit collision bounds preserve the authored cell footprint while visible slopes interpolate at the edge. Graph entry and exit are DeathWard progression points; template restricted entrance sides are respected, but large-room source multiple door-slot offsets are not yet mapped one-for-one. Normal room weights are a local use of storedSTB weights, not a claim about native special-room selection. The ordinary DeathWard boss money/item reward remains. The killed/escaped distinction changes the bomb bonus and kill event; source unlocks and the1/7 collectible bonus are not implemented. Original visual style/player defaults are unchanged. Charge/recovery uses source6-8 repeats after the initial pass, the same route and frame46 recovery projectile. Fixed30Hz force-then-retention integration, world scale0.1, velocity cap40, charge cooldown10s, mine cooldown5s, local periodic phase0.5s and recovery delay1/30s are explicit adaptations. Recovery flight1.1s/gravity12/prediction0.2s and fire speed6/range12/radius0.45/trail2.5s/damage10 are local tuning. Recovery waits for a required shot under capacity pressure; impacted carriers wait for full four-ray burst capacity. Fire stops at cover/pits and preserves existing hostile-team rules.
